notes: GAAP/accrual presentation (business-type receivables, accrued expenses and a proprietary Statement of Cash Flows; the budget schedule reconciles budgetary basis to accrual basis, p10); later years are modified cash. Governmental lines from the governmental funds statement Total column (p4): fund balances 1,034,650 (beginning, as restated as printed) -> 3,751,271. Bond proceeds 2,461,774 printed among revenues (Fire Hall Fund) recorded as a receipt line (Bond Proceeds). Other financing: transfers in 1,439,123, transfers out 1,162,598 and 'Miscellaneous revenues and expenditures' (9,299) (Bond and Interest column) as other_financing. ending_cash = Cash and cash equivalents (claim on cash) 3,736,247 from the governmental funds balance sheet (p3), as in FY2023; cash with county treasurer 15,024 printed separately; beginning cash not printed. Business-type from the proprietary funds statement p6 Total column (net position 8,512,757 -> 8,881,646); proprietary cash flows from pp7-8. Grant proceeds 290,395 = ARPA Grant in the ARPA Fund (p11), federal; proprietary Grants 1,999 (Garbage) has no grantor printed (budget schedule Federal receipts 296,659 does not tie to the printed grant lines). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), lines by Governmental / Business-Type column. Detail: major governmental funds from p4 fund columns, other governmental funds per fund column from the combining schedule (p11), proprietary funds per fund from p6; the all-funds budget schedule (pp9-10) is not recorded (function totals only, as in FY2023). Sales Tax Fund 'Other revenues' 6,421 is printed as Sales tax in the p4 Other Governmental Funds column; TIF 'County treasurer revenues' 18,238 printed as Property taxes there. Read pages 1-11 of 11
